items.title: Glover Compton Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: And when I left Dreamland, I joined Jimmy's band.

ctx.x: He was Tops. Yeah. Can you tell us about that band with Jimmy Noon, and Tommy Ladner in that band regularly at the Dreamland? That record you made, you know, had Jimmy Noon on it.

Yeah, well, Jimmy played that with us that night. But he wasn't regular at Dreamland. Jimmy preferred that combo of his own. And when I left Dreamland, I joined Jimmy's band. Where was that? That was at Edelweiss. That's where we played. That was where every, from all the other nightclubs that come, that was Edelweiss. They don't play all night.
